name: Cairo, Nile Cruise and Hurghada Package
description: Scout around the incredible finds of Cairo Nile Cruise, and Hurghada Tour with Ibis Egypt Tours, Travel through history with the diversity of this vacation while getting the chance to stare at the glory of Pyramids of Giza, walkthrough Karnak Temple, try snorkel on the Red Sea at Hurghada and more with Egypt LuxuryTours.
overview: Scout around the incredible finds of Cairo Nile Cruise, and Hurghada Tour with Ibis Egypt Tours, Travel through history with the diversity of this vacation while getting the chance to stare at the glory of Pyramids of Giza, walkthrough Karnak Temple, try snorkel on the Red Sea at Hurghada and more with Egypt LuxuryTours.
highlights: Visit Edfu Temple & East Bank of Luxor

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo Airport, Ibis Egypt tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Egypt tours representative will pick you up from your hotel after enjoying the relish of your breakfast, enjoy your sightseeing tours to Pyramids of Giza, the ruins of Memphis City, and Sakkara Step Pyramid start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy your Lunch meal at a high quality oriental restaurant in Cairo, continue your tour by visiting the ruins of Memphis City including the Open Air Museum of Ramses II, finally visit Sakkara Step pyramid, at the end of your day tours back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy Tasty breakfast at your hotel, then start to embrace Cairo culture by visiting the Egyptian museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, then move to the remarkable site Citadel of Salah El-Dein and the Alabaster Mosque, enjoy tasty Egyptian lunch at oreintal restaurant, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches ), visit Ben Ezra synagogue, at the end of your tour transfer to Giza train station for departure to Aswan by night Sleeper train, Dinner. Overnight in Sleeper train

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise
itinerary.description: IbisTours Egypt representative will pick you up from Aswan train station, then he will escort you to your Nile Cruise, check into your Nile Cruise, taste your unforgettable excursions to the High Dam, head towards the Unfinished Obelisk, amuse your eyes while visiting Philae Temple, Belongs to Isis and Hathor goddesses, Lunch on board your Nile Cruise, Dinner. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo Temples Tour
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board, enjoy the scenic sailing to Kom Ombo, and explore the Temple dedicated to the two gods Sobek and Horus. Afterward, continue sailing towards Edfu, where you will have lunch on board./p> Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Visit Edfu Temple & East Bank of Luxor
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast on-board. Try a new adventure by a horse-drawn carriage to visit the Edfu Temple of God Horus. Then return to the Nile Cruise, and continue sailing to Luxor via Esna lock. Once the cruise arrives in Luxor, visit Luxor Temple and Karnak complex on the east bank of Luxor. After that, you will go back to your cruise. Enjoy your dinner on-board. In the evening, enjoy the Galabia Party on the cruise. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: West Bank Tour / Luxor to Hurghada
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast on board before disembarking at 08:00 AM; today we will say goodbye to the Nile Cruise, as today is your final departure day from your cruise. Our Egyptology tour guide will join you to visit Hatshepsut temple, Colossi of Memnon & Valley of the Kings. Finally, travel to Hurghada by VIP group bus; catch your bus trip a journey of around four hours. Check into your hotel, and spend the final few days of your holiday relaxing and soaking up the sun - or swimming, diving and snorkeling in the warm, clear waters of the Red Sea. Overnight in Hurghada

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Hurghada
itinerary.description: Enjoy your tasty breakfast at your hotel, it is your chance to escape the crowds, manage to relax at the stunning beaches of Hurghada, optional excursion to tuck into spectacular islands like Mahmya and Tiran Island, plenty of water activities are waiting for you, swimming, diving or snorkeling are available. Overnight in Hurghada

itinerary.title: Hurghada to Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast at the hotel, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will escort you to Hurghada bus station to catch your bus back to Cairo. . Ibis representative will escort you to your hotel in Cairo Optional Cairo Night tour to explore Cairo beauty and culture. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.

English-speaking guide in Cairo, Luxor, and Aswan.

A Bottle of mineral during tours.

Entrance fees to the above-mentioned sites as mentioned in the itinerary.
